issue: Intermittent E17 high-pressure trip during peak afternoon heat
diagnosis: Discharge pressure transducer PT-1 showed fluctuating reference voltage (+0.8V bias). Mechanical gauge read 172 PSI while sensor reported 214 PSI.
action_taken: Replaced discharge pressure transducer PT-1. Recalibrated analog input channel on DDC board. Verified normal operation at 170 PSI.
technician_notes: Unit 017 is installed adjacent to west wall exhaust vent. Condenser coils accumulate dust quickly here. Cleaned exterior coil face with low-pressure rinse. Warned facility manager that repeat high pressure in 2-3 months likely indicates coil fouling or exhaust recirc.
